title: Controlled Components
description: Learn how to control form inputs with React state.

data.text: In React, form inputs can be **controlled** or **uncontrolled**. Controlled components have their value managed by React state, making them predictable and easy to validate.

data.title: Controlled Input
Controlled Checkbox
Controlled Select

data.text: Handle multiple inputs with a single handler by using the input's `name` attribute.

data.title: Multiple Inputs
Always Provide onChange
data.text: If you set `value` on an input without `onChange`, the input becomes read-only. Always pair controlled inputs with an onChange handler.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Controlled inputs have value managed by state
Use onChange to update state on input changes
Use a single handler for multiple inputs with name attributes
data.takeaway: Controlled components give you full control over form data. Let's explore more form patterns.
